problem.symptom: The old ground homography compressed the current two-disc lateral geometry after the vehicle-top repair.

diagnosis.reason_intrinsics_reused: No evidence that the lens or image resolution changed; the observed fault is consistent with an external camera pose change.
diagnosis.interpretation: The old and current ground views are not compatible with one fixed external pose. The approximately 10.19 degree value is a constrained pose-fit estimate, not a direct mechanical angle measurement.

method.name: fixed_intrinsics_two_disc_center_scale_and_projected_circle_shape_pose_fit
method.absolute_metric_constraint: Two physical disc centers are 0.50 m apart.
method.shape_constraint: Projected circle aspect and orientation from both discs.
method.yellow_width_note: The running detector is left-only and synthesizes the opposite boundary at 0.91 m, so the reported 0.91 m cannot independently validate this calibration.

locked_pair_diagnostic.interpretation: The repaired metric geometry passes. Rejection is now caused by the current discs being on the same side of the active yellow-derived route, plus a 0.0127 m takeover-range excess. Do not alter calibration to hide route-relative placement failures.

remaining_validation.procedure: With the vehicle locked, project two independent ground marks exactly 0.50 m apart at approximately x=0.8 m. Prefer repeating at x=0.5, 0.8 and 1.1 m.
remaining_validation.reason: The current two-disc center distance was itself an input to the pose fit, and the current right yellow boundary is synthesized rather than observed.

rollback.instruction: Stop the candidate launch and relaunch current_car_navigation.launch with config:=.../config/current_car_calibrated_640x480.yaml and start_enabled:=false.
